Content: MemorySmith supports persistent markdown-backed pages stored in Data/Pages as a sibling to Data/Memories and Data/Graph. User-created markdown files under Data/Pages are valid project wiki content and should be committed unless explicitly temporary/private. FilePageService provides list, search, get, save, delete, Markdig HTML rendering, and asset saving under Data/Pages/assets. Page assets are served from /page-assets so markdown images and browser-supported audio/video can be embedded. The /pages UI is separate from memory search and /api/pages exposes page CRUD, search, and rendered HTML. The editor has a toolbar for common markdown inserts plus an InputFile-backed image upload/embed control that saves assets through SaveAssetAsync and inserts markdown image tags with the returned assets/... path. It also has toggleable live preview, manual preview refresh, unsaved-change prompts, and a fill-height split editor/preview layout.
